title: Agnus Dei (Baccusi, Missa Quando lieta sperai)
desc: Ippolito Baccusi, Missa Quando lieta sperai, Agnus Dei, before 1589. 5 voices (Cantus, Quintus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0023_5); edited by Maxime Popineau, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
